name: runward-integrations
description: MIT recipes outside runward's verdict (ADR-0122): each one regenerates one report from the project's own tools, in a CI step pinned out of the agent's reach, normalised as ADR-0073 option 1, with the requires: rows it satisfies, a planted-sabotage control and a named maintainer. A recipe is counted only while its control passes. Imports nothing from runward; runward imports nothing from it.
